objects.description: Broadcom patched two VMware Workstation/Fusion VM-escape bugs. Broadcom published advisory VMSA-2026-0007, patching two vulnerabilities in VMware Workstation and Fusion that allow an attacker inside a virtual machine to execute code on the underlying host.
